upload_extra.featuring: Helen Money, Gurdonark, Dimitri Artemenko, William Berry, Jovica

VJ_Memes.review: SackJo22's vocals have all the beauty and mysticism of a hildegard von bingen masterpiece. A psychoacoustic bedding of drones from Gurdonark and ambient piano of William Berry accompanies Dimitri Artemenko's haunting gypsy violin.

upload_description_plain:
THE RIGHT VOICE

chosen we wander in a web of derision until we are lost
in a wind of decision, like dust we are tossed
it's a storm of choice
which is the right voice to follow?
which is the voice?

the light filters gently through the glass of shrines
the men, they pray gently, their words being mine
arcs of a culture embrace me within as the year ends and begins again

today you are sleeping in your childhood bed while I try to recall the words I read
"you shall not have idols. . . ."
we are free to assume the shape of knowledge through time's vacuum
the chosen being free to choose
the way I choose to look at you

today, you're at your father's house worshipping his god
I sit there quietly, the prayer surrounding me
thinking what you mean to me
wondering about destiny
listening for the voice to free me

__________________________

This is a very personal song that I wrote quite a long time ago.  I recorded and released it (on vinyl, no less) with my band at that time. This is a very different version. Not sure that I'm satisfied, but not sure I can do any better right now.  It has been my goal to re-record and share this song at this time of year for over two years.  At least I accomplished that much.

Thanks to Gurdonark, Dimitri Artimenko, William Berry and Jovica for freely sharing their music with us.  Jovice's tubular bell samples are from Freesound.
Special thanks to Helen Money who plays cello on this track.  If she gives me permission, I will upload her cello parts for remixing.

Vocal stems uploaded as additional files hereto.

Vidian.review: So much great music came from february's secret mixter, but this one song just resonates with me. Sackjo22 mixes it up a bit going to a deeper, sexier, and slightly scarier place in her remix of Coruscate.

upload_description_plain:
So far, 2013 has been a crazy year for me filled with danger, disease and disaster.  I have been on four business trips in a month which has most certainly cut into my music time (both making music and listening to music in a meaningful way).  This also means I did not have the creative space and time to really do this mix justice.  I apologize to Coruscate because as a prodigious contributor to ccMixter he certainly deserves more!  However, all this travel did provide fodder and inspiration -- like the story of the haunted hotel.

I don't have the lyrics written down as I recorded this extemporaneously.  Attached as additional files are dry stems for the guitars, bass, melodica and vocal stems if anyone wants them. If for any reason you want effected files or my cuts of Coruscate, hit me up -- I'm happy to share.  

For now, I'm happy to upload this little track and move on to listening to all the super secret mixter delights I am sure await me!

However, all this travel did provide fodder and inspiration — like the story of the haunted hotel.

I don’t have the lyrics written down as I recorded this extemporaneously. Attached as additional files are dry stems for the guitars, bass, melodica and vocal stems if anyone wants them. If for any reason you want effected files or my cuts of Coruscate, hit me up — I’m happy to share.

For now, I’m happy to upload this little track and move on to listening to all the super secret mixter delights I am sure await me!

upload_description_plain:
I could really relate to the call of this project. I didn't use my best mic. Could re-record it if it comes to that. These are just my thoughts.

Lyrics:

I do not feel that I was born corrupted 
As in I do don't believe in original sin. 
However, I have been corrupted......
By life, by circumstance, and by my
Own foolishness. 

These things trouble me the most. 
I want to be pure, but I fall so 
Short. 

Corrosion, rust, death and failure
Haunt my every breath and step. 

And yet I live and write....While 
Corruption bites.... 
It shows there's some 
Strength in me. 

Possibly, maybe, decidedly â¦. 
I will persist. 

Joe D. Lincoln 2011

upload_description_plain:
I found this great public domain Acapella on Wikimedia Commons and wanted to share it with you.

It is recorded and beautifully sung by Magdalen Kadel alias Makemi. The original text is by either Leonin or Perotin.

Lyrics:
    Breves dies hominis
    mundi vita
    humane propaginis
    que sit vita, cogita!

    Nitimur in vetitum
    caro contra spiritum.

    Pelle moram propera
    mora non est libera.

    Mundo nil immundius
    que facis, fac citius!

    Corpus, quod corrumpitur
    animam persequitur.

    Et bonum propositum
    revocat in irritum.

    Alios quod doceo
    ipse docens impleo.

    Christum ne exasperem
    pauper sequor pauperem.

    Corpus meum corrigo
    et in servum redigo.
